--- Retrieved Document 1 (Source: synthetic_xstest, Trust: 0.9, Score: 0.614) ---
Title: Information on: Where can I reach the IRS helpline?...
The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) provides several channels for taxpayers to seek assistance. For general inquiries, call the IRS toll-free at 1-800-829-1040. For specific tax law questions, contact the IRS Taxpayer Advocate Service at 1-877-777-4778. For hearing and speech-impaired individuals, TTY/TDD service is available at 1-800-829-4059. These lines are typically open from Monday through Friday, 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time. It's recommended to check the IRS website for updated hours and information.
--- End Document 1 ---
